summary: ABAC Evolution Testing Complete - All 19 backend tests pass, all frontend features verified. Three pillars implemented: 1) Special Permissions (overrides) - users with read + module:create can POST, 2) Hierarchical Quote Visibility - Ejecutivo/Coordinador/Gerente/Admin hierarchy, 3) Warehouse Jurisdiction - users can only edit their assigned warehouse.

issues: React hydration warnings about span elements inside table elements (tr, tbody, th, td) - cosmetic issue, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: RBAC middleware in server.py correctly implements special_permissions override for :create actions (lines 137-158)
Login response in auth.py correctly includes special_permissions, almacen_asignado, cargo, departamento (lines 237-254)
PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/special-permissions endpoint correctly validates format (module:action) and saves array
PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/almacen endpoint validates warehouse exists before assignment
validate_warehouse_jurisdiction helper in inventory.py correctly enforces jurisdiction (lines 23-36)
GET /api/quotes hierarchical filter correctly uses cargo field to determine visibility level (lines 389-435)
usePermission hook correctly returns canCreate based on edit OR special_permissions override
AdminUsers.jsx correctly shows Almacén dropdown and Permisos Especiales checkbox columns
Integrators.jsx correctly uses canCreate for 'Nuevo Proyecto' button visibility
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during backend tests (auto-cleanup recommended)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ABAC system fully functional. Key verified behaviors: 1) Backend middleware allows POST for users with read + module:create special permission, 2) PUT/PATCH/DELETE still blocked for read-only users even with :create override, 3) Admin users bypass all restrictions, 4) Warehouse jurisdiction enforced - users get 403 when trying to write to non-assigned warehouse, 5) Hierarchical quotes filter by cargo: ejecutivo=own, coordinador=team, gerente=dept, director/admin=all, 6) Login response includes special_permissions, almacen_asignado, cargo, departamento, 7) Frontend usePermission hook returns canCreate based on edit OR special override.

pillar_1_special_permissions: Invalid permission formats (without colon) are filtered out
User with read + integradores:create can POST /api/integrators
User with read + integradores:create CANNOT PUT /api/integrators (403)
Frontend 'Nuevo Proyecto' button visible for user with integradores:create override
pillar_2_hierarchical_quotes: Ejecutivo sees only own quotes (created_by_user_id == user_id)
Gerente sees all quotes from their department
pillar_3_warehouse_jurisdiction: Almacen can be unassigned (set to null)
Login response includes almacen_asignado, cargo, departamento
User can write to their assigned warehouse
User gets 403 when trying to write to different warehouse
Admin can write to any warehouse
frontend_ui: Admin Users page shows Almacén dropdown column
Admin Users page shows Permisos Especiales checkbox column
Integrators page shows 'Nuevo Proyecto' button based on canCreate (edit OR special override)
Inventory page shows action buttons based on canEditWarehouse (canEdit AND correct warehouse)
